parts: Hello. I am Maya. I build customer service teams.
I read your handbook and your on-call sheet. Your documents answer most of my questions. I have two more questions for you.
Question one. Sometimes a Client feels lonely, sleeps badly, or does not eat well. We call this a Watch sign.
After how many days in a row should we treat a Watch sign as urgent? The usual answer is three days.
Question two. Is there anything about a specific Client that we must always escalate? For example, a health condition or a known risk.
Thank you. I have your answers. I chose five skills for your team.
Your handbook offers medication reminder calls. We do not have that skill yet, so we are writing it now.
Your team is ready. Meet Grace, Leo, Ben, Dana and Sam.
Hello Linda. This is Grace from BrightDays. I spoke with your father, Walter, at ten this morning.
He felt dizzy, and he fell in the kitchen. He says he is not hurt. Rosa, his caregiver, will visit him at three o'clock today.
Priya, our on-call coordinator, will call you soon. Your father was calm, and he asked me about the Giants game. We will send you another update after Rosa's visit.
We set up BrightDays on this stage in one minute. Any business can do the same. Upload your documents, answer two questions, and meet your team.
